name: Mary Robinson
bio: Poet, born 1857. She met Vernon Lee in 1880 and, on the Y90s account, the two developed a romantic friendship that lasted until Robinson's marriage in 1887 to the orientalist James Darmesteter. Lee first visited her in London in 1881, where Robinson introduced her to the Burne-Joneses, Edmund Gosse, the Morrises, the Rossettis and Oscar Wilde; Robinson's own published recollection of visiting "Casa Paget" in Florence is cited by Pulham for the cosmopolitan range of the Paget circle. She died in 1944.
bio_note: Dates (1857-1944) and the relationship account from Patricia Pulham's Y90s biography of Vernon Lee (2018/2019), fetched and read in full 2026-08-03. Robinson does not appear in Wilde's Complete Letters; her link to this map runs through Lee. No biography of Robinson was consulted so far, so the record is thin by design.

context_engagements.note: French orientalist. Robinson's marriage to him in 1887 is what ended her attachment to Vernon Lee, per Pulham's Y90s biography of Lee; Kit Anstruther-Thomson replaced her as Lee's companion the same year. Off-roster; recorded because the marriage is the terminus of the lee--robinson record.
